rationale: Archive CarbonCount Holdings 1 LLC from published operating PortCo views while preserving its active legal identity, 50/50 member ownership, financing milestones, and evidence. Current HASI and SEC materials consistently describe CCH1 as a jointly governed investment, aggregation, and financing vehicle holding project interests, receivables, and debt securities rather than a manager-level operating infrastructure company.

companyFieldUpdates.description: CarbonCount Holdings 1 LLC is a 50/50 HASI-KKR co-investment, aggregation, and financing vehicle established to invest in eligible climate-positive projects and related interests in the United States. Public filings show a mixed portfolio of equity-method investments, receivables, and debt securities and identify affiliate service providers rather than a standalone workforce or customer-facing operating business. It remains an active legal investment vehicle, but it is archived from the direct operating infrastructure PortCo universe because it does not meet the manager-level operating-company boundary.
